title: What happens when processing outlives visibility?
description: Inject a processing or consumer failure, then change the visibility, retry, heartbeat, and idempotency contracts to see the user-visible outcome.

scenarios.label: Slow but healthy handler
scenarios.detail: The worker needs 75 seconds, but its receipt can become visible while work is still running.

scenarios.label: Crash after side effect
scenarios.detail: The worker commits the business change, then crashes before DeleteMessage reaches SQS.

scenarios.label: Transient dependency failure
scenarios.detail: The first delivery fails before the side effect; the second succeeds after the visibility timeout.

scenarios.label: Permanent schema error
scenarios.detail: Every delivery fails validation. A finite receive budget should quarantine it for diagnosis.
